text.text_excerpt: I placed a order for pickup and the person who answered the phone seemed uninterested in taking the order. They stated they'd call when we could be on the way to pick up the food. That I appreciated because who wants to sit for 30-45mins waiting for a meal. We ordered the Creole Queen which had shrimp, crawfish and crabmeat. It was extremely delicious great flavor and it didn't have that "seafood taste" so they really must've cleaned the seafood they put in the beignets. I was a tad disappointed that they had shells in the beignet when I took a bite. We also ordered the stuph'd bacon cheeseburger. The burger was good and cooked well done. We visited for the first time today and the food and customer service were both amazing. We had the creole queen, strawberry, sweet potato, and regular beignets and they were all absolutely amazing. The creole queen is worth the price of admission! The sweet potato was a close second. I'm not so sad about Morning Call closing in nearby City Park anymore because I'll be taking my kids here from now on for their beignet fix. The venue is also nice and quaint, with a relaxing courtyard out back. I almost forgot to add- my husband tried one of their stuffed burgers (burger stuffed with hot sausage) and he loved it. We will definitely be back.

I'm gonna get fat y'all, this place is amazing!! So far my family and I have tried the savory Philly Cheese Steak Stuph'D beignets and the Grilled Shrimp Stuph'D beignets. We have tried the sweet Apple Stuph'D beignets and the Strawberry Stuph'D beignets. Also, we ordered traditional beignets because our brother was in town and he had never had them. The traditional were just ok to me, but everything else was SO good that I keep raving about it to all my friends and fam! I seriously can't wait to try all the other flavors of beignets and the Stuph'D burgers. Even the Strawberry Lemonade is tasty. The staff is friendly and the waiting/dining area is cozy.
